context: Tatsuya-country and his daughter Asuka share a long letter exchange.
purpose: Married couple sharing one daughter's letter together tenderly.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: A letter came from our daughter.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate opening. Warm Tohoku dialect coloring underneath. Voice lifts slightly on 'daughter'—pride threaded through quietness. Gentle, like turning something precious over in his hands.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: That's wonderful. Read it to me.
lines.style: Soft intake of breath at the start. Genuinely eager but contained—the eagerness of someone who listens more than speaks. Leans in slightly, full attention.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Measured pace. Each word given its own weight. The relief in his voice is quiet but unmistakable. Trailing slightly at the end, like he's letting himself sit with the good news.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Soft, knowing tone. The repetition matters to her—she's said this before, will say it again. Not tired of it; comforted by the ritual. Gentle smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: She's planning to visit next month.
lines.style: Brightness enters his voice for the first time. Still measured—still Tatsuya—but unmistakably pleased. A small lift on 'next month,' like he's already thinking ahead.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 楽しみね、お料理準備しよう。
lines.en: I'm so looking forward to it. We should start planning what to cook.
lines.style: Practical warmth. She's already moving into action—the teacher organizing, the woman preparing. Genuine delight wrapped in purpose. Light, forward-moving energy.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: Yeah. Let's make all her favorites.
lines.style: Agreement that settles into affection. Soft Tohoku cadence on 'yeah.' The 'all her favorites' carries the tenderness of a man who has been paying attention for years. Warm closing note.
